targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp                                                 AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_aft_thrstr_rpm"
    ELSE "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_fwd_thrstr_rpm"
  END                                                       AS speed
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                      AS time,
  "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" AS torque
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                                 AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_aft_thrstr_rpm" * "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" / 60 * 2 * PI()
    ELSE "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_fwd_thrstr_rpm" * "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" / 60 * 2 * PI()
  END                                                       AS "power"
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_emotor_temp" ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_emotor_temp" END AS e_motor_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_igbt_temp"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_igbt_temp"   END AS igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm"   END AS speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_torque_nm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_torque_nm"   END AS torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_current"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_current"  END AS "current",
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_voltage"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_voltage"  END AS voltage
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                                            AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_current"
    ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_current"
  END                                                  AS "current"
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                            AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_voltage"
    ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_voltage"
  END                                                  AS voltage
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                                 AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__thruster_test.r_power_aft_trstr_kw"
    ELSE "devices__thruster_test.r_power_fwd_trstr_kw"
  END                                                       AS "power"
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                             AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_emotor_temp"
    ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_emotor_temp"
  END                                                   AS e_motor_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_igbt_temp"
    ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_igbt_temp"
  END                                                   AS igbt_temp
FROM public.prop_test__data                                                   
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                                  AS time,
  station_selected__value                                    AS station_selected,
  reg_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  reg_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  prop_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                     AS aft_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  prop_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                     AS fwd_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  man_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  man_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  ((aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  ((fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal
FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                                                  AS time,
  station_selected__value                                    AS station_selected,
  -- reg_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  -- reg_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  -- prop_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                     AS aft_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  -- prop_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                     AS fwd_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  -- man_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  -- man_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  ((aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  ((fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal
FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_sbhelm
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_torque AS (
  SELECT
    greptime_timestamp AS time,
    "HydrTankTemp.Value" AS torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
  ORDER BY greptime_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_torque AS (
  SELECT
    greptime_timestamp AS time,
    "HydrTankTemp.Value" AS torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
  ORDER BY greptime_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  'Aradex 1'                    AS device,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.time
    ELSE fwd1.time
  END                           AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.speed
    ELSE fwd1.speed
  END                           AS speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.torque
    ELSE fwd1.torque
  END                           AS aradex_torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_torque.torque
    ELSE fwd_torque.torque
  END                           AS measured_torque,
  NULL                          AS torque_setpoint,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.power_stage_temp
    ELSE fwd1.power_stage_temp
  END                            AS power_stage_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.igbt_temp
    ELSE fwd1.igbt_temp
  END                            AS igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1."power"
    ELSE fwd1."power"
  END                           AS "power"
FROM fwd1, aft1, fwd_torque, aft_torque

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Aradex 2'                    AS device,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.time
    ELSE fwd2.time
  END                           AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.speed
    ELSE fwd2.speed
  END                           AS speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.torque
    ELSE fwd2.torque
  END                           AS aradex_torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_torque.torque
    ELSE fwd_torque.torque
  END                           AS measured_torque,
  NULL                          AS torque_setpoint,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.power_stage_temp
    ELSE fwd2.power_stage_temp
  END                            AS power_stage_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.igbt_temp
    ELSE fwd2.igbt_temp
  END                            AS igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2."power"
    ELSE fwd2."power"
  END                           AS "power"
FROM fwd2, aft2, fwd_torque, aft_torque

ORDER BY device

WITH fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN  LEAST(aft1.time, aft2.time)
    ELSE LEAST(fwd1.time, fwd2.time)
  END                                             AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.speed
    ELSE fwd1.speed
  END                                             AS aradex1_speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.speed
    ELSE fwd2.speed
  END                                             AS aradex2_speed
FROM fwd1, fwd2,aft1, aft2

WITH fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    torque__value AS torque,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    torque__value AS torque,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    torque__value AS torque,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    torque__value AS torque,
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
fwd_torque AS (
  SELECT
    greptime_timestamp AS time,
    "HydrTankTemp.Value" AS torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
),
aft_torque AS (
  SELECT
    greptime_timestamp AS time,
    "HydrTankTemp.Value" AS torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN LEAST(aft1.time, aft2.time)
    ELSE LEAST(fwd1.time, fwd2.time)
  END                                             AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.torque
    ELSE fwd1.torque
  END                                             AS aradex1_torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.torque
    ELSE fwd2.torque
  END                                             AS aradex2_torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_torque.torque
    ELSE fwd_torque.torque
  END                                             AS measured_torque
FROM fwd1, fwd2, aft1, aft2, fwd_torque, aft_torque

WITH fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power",
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power",
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power",
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power",
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN LEAST(aft1.time, aft2.time)
    ELSE LEAST(fwd1.time, fwd2.time)
  END                                             AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1."power"
    ELSE fwd1."power"
  END                                             AS aradex1_power,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2."power"
    ELSE fwd2."power"
  END                                             AS aradex2_power
FROM fwd1, fwd2,aft1, aft2

SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN LEAST(supply.time, aft_return.time)
    ELSE LEAST(supply.time, fwd_return.time)
  END                               AS time,
  supply.temperature                AS supply_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_return.temperature
    ELSE fwd_return.temperature
  END                               AS return_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_return.temperature - supply.temperature
    ELSE fwd_return.temperature - supply.temperature
  END                               AS delta_temp
FROM (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft_supply
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS supply
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft_supply
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS aft_return
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd_supply
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_return

SELECT 
  LEAST(fwd_ara1.time, fwd_ara2.time)     AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_ara1.power_stage_temperature
    ELSE fwd_ara1.power_stage_temperature
  END                                     AS ara1_power_stage_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_ara1.igbt_temperature
    ELSE fwd_ara1.igbt_temperature
  END                                     AS ara1_power_igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_ara2.power_stage_temperature
    ELSE fwd_ara2.power_stage_temperature
  END                                     AS ara2_power_stage_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_ara2.igbt_temperature
    ELSE fwd_ara2.igbt_temperature
  END                                     AS ara2_power_igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_oil.tank_temperature
    ELSE fwd_oil.tank_temperature
  END                                     AS oil_tank_temp
FROM (
  SELECT
    timestamp               AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temperature,
    temp_igbt__value        AS igbt_temperature
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_ara1
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
    timestamp               AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temperature,
    temp_igbt__value        AS igbt_temperature
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_ara2
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp               AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temperature,
    temp_igbt__value        AS igbt_temperature
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS aft_ara1
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
    timestamp               AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temperature,
    temp_igbt__value        AS igbt_temperature
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS aft_ara2
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    greptime_timestamp AS time,
    "HydrTankTemp.Value" AS tank_temperature
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
  ORDER BY greptime_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS aft_oil
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    greptime_timestamp AS time,
    "HydrTankTemp.Value" AS tank_temperature
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
  ORDER BY greptime_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_oil

SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN LEAST(aft_supply.time, aft_return1.time, aft_return2.time)
    ELSE LEAST(fwd_supply.time, fwd_return1.time, fwd_return2.time)
  END                               AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_supply.temperature
    ELSE fwd_supply.temperature
  END                               AS supply_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_return1.temperature
    ELSE fwd_return1.temperature
  END                               AS return1_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_return2.temperature
    ELSE fwd_return2.temperature
  END                               AS return2_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_return1.temperature - aft_supply.temperature
    ELSE fwd_return1.temperature - fwd_supply.temperature
  END                               AS delta1_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_return2.temperature - aft_supply.temperature
    ELSE fwd_return2.temperature - fwd_supply.temperature
  END                               AS delta2_temp 
FROM (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft_supply
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS aft_supply
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft1_return
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS aft_return1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft2_return
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS aft_return2
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd_supply
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_supply
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd1_return
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_return1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    timestamp          AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd2_return
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp
  DESC LIMIT 1
) AS fwd_return2

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempu_1__value
    ELSE fwd_thrust_windingtempu_1__value
  END AS winding_temp_u1,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempv_1__value
    ELSE fwd_thrust_windingtempv_1__value
  END AS winding_temp_v1,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempw_1__value
    ELSE fwd_thrust_winding_temp_w_1__value
  END AS winding_temp_w1,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempu_2__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_windingtempu_2__value
  END AS winding_temp_u2,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempv_2__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_windingtempv_2__value
  END AS winding_temp_v2,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempw_2__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_windingtempw_2__value
  END AS winding_temp_w2,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN stern_thrust_bearing_de_temp__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_bearing_de_temp__value
  END AS bearing_de_temp,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN stern_thrust_bearing_nde_temp__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_bearing_nde_temp__value
  END AS bearing_nde_temp
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH motor AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN motor.timestamp
    ELSE LEAST(motor.timestamp, fwd1.time, fwd2.time)  
  END                                                                          AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN motor."devices__thruster_test.r_power_aft_trstr_kw"
    ELSE motor."devices__thruster_test.r_power_fwd_trstr_kw"
  END                                                                           AS motor_power,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN ((aft1.speed * aft1.torque) + (aft2.speed * aft2.torque)) / 60 * 2 * PI() 
    ELSE ((fwd1.speed * fwd1.torque) + (fwd2.speed * fwd2.torque)) / 60 * 2 * PI() 
  END                                                                           AS theoretical_power,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.power + aft2.power
    ELSE fwd1.power + fwd2.power
  END                                                                           AS aradex_power
FROM motor, fwd1, fwd2, aft1, aft2

WITH motor AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd1 AS (
  SELECT

),
fwd2 AS (

  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

aft1 AS (

aft2 AS (

    power__value AS "power"

SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN motor.timestamp
    ELSE LEAST(motor.timestamp, fwd1.time, fwd2.time)  
  END                                                                          AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN motor."devices__thruster_test.r_power_aft_trstr_kw"
    ELSE motor."devices__thruster_test.r_power_fwd_trstr_kw"
  END                                                                           AS motor_power,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN ((aft1.speed * aft1.torque) + (aft2.speed * aft2.torque)) / 60 * 2 * PI() 
    ELSE ((fwd1.speed * fwd1.torque) + (fwd2.speed * fwd2.torque)) / 60 * 2 * PI() 
  END                                                                           AS theoretical_power,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.power + aft2.power
    ELSE fwd1.power + fwd2.power
  END                                                                           AS aradex_power
FROM motor, fwd1, fwd2, aft1, aft2

WITH ps_helm AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    station_selected__value                                AS station_selected,
    CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
      THEN aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value
      ELSE fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value
    END                                                    AS lever_speed
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
sb_helm AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    station_selected__value                                AS station_selected,
    CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
      THEN aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value
      ELSE fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value
    END                                                    AS lever_speed
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_sbhelm
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
motor AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
	LEAST(
		motor.timestamp,
		ps_helm.timestamp,
		sb_helm.timestamp)                                      AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN ps_helm.station_selected THEN ((ps_helm.lever_speed /327.0 ) -50) * 2
    WHEN sb_helm.station_selected THEN ((sb_helm.lever_speed /327.0 ) -50) * 2
    ELSE 0
  END                                                       AS lever_pos,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN motor."devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm"
    ELSE motor."devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm"
  END                                                       AS motor_speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
   THEN aft1.speed
   ELSE fwd1.speed
  END                                                       AS aradex1_speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
   THEN aft2.speed
   ELSE fwd2.speed
  END                                                       AS aradex2_speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
   THEN aft1."power" + aft2."power"
   ELSE fwd1."power" + fwd2."power"
  END                                                       AS aradex_power,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
   THEN aft1.torque
   ELSE fwd1.torque
  END                                                       AS aradex1_torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
   THEN aft2.torque
   ELSE fwd2.torque
  END                                                       AS aradex2_torque
FROM motor, ps_helm, sb_helm, fwd1, fwd2,aft1,aft2

WITH motor AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
      THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm"
      ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm"
    END                                                 AS motor_speed
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
	  THEN LEAST(motor.timestamp, aft1.time)
    ELSE LEAST(motor.timestamp, fwd1.time)
  END                                                             AS time,
  'Aradex 1'                                                      AS device,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.speed
	  ELSE fwd1.speed
  END                                                             AS aradex1_speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft1.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1)
	  ELSE fwd1.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1)
  END                                                             AS gear_ratio,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN 100 * (aft1.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1) - $gear_ratio) / $gear_ratio
	  ELSE 100 * (fwd1.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1) - $gear_ratio) / $gear_ratio
  END                                                             AS gear_ratio_rel_error
FROM motor, fwd1, aft1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN LEAST(motor.timestamp, aft2.time)
    ELSE LEAST(motor.timestamp, fwd2.time)
  END                                                             AS time,
  'Aradex 2'                                                      AS device,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.speed
	  ELSE fwd2.speed
  END                                                             AS aradex1_speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft2.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1)
	  ELSE fwd2.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1)
  END                                                             AS gear_ratio,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN 100 * (aft2.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1) - $gear_ratio) / $gear_ratio
	  ELSE 100 * (fwd2.speed / GREATEST(motor_speed, 1) - $gear_ratio) / $gear_ratio
  END                                                             AS gear_ratio_rel_error
FROM motor, fwd2, aft2
ORDER BY device

WITH torque_values AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
      THEN LEAST(motor.timestamp, thruster_ara1.timestamp, thruster_ara2.timestamp, aft_torque.time)
      ELSE LEAST(motor.timestamp, thruster_ara1.timestamp, thruster_ara2.timestamp, fwd_torque.time)
    END                                                              AS time,
    CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
      THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_torque_nm"
      ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_torque_nm"
    END                                                              AS motor_torque,
    thruster_ara1.torque__value                                      AS aradex1_torque,
    thruster_ara2.torque__value                                      AS aradex2_torque,
    CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
      THEN aft_torque.torque
      ELSE fwd_torque.torque
    END                                                              AS measured_torque
  FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS thruster_ara1
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS thruster_ara2
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM public.prop_test__data
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS motor
  CROSS JOIN (
	SELECT
	  greptime_timestamp AS time,
	  "ShearBeamCalculated.Value" AS torque
	FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_fwd
	WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
	ORDER BY greptime_timestamp DESC
	LIMIT 1
  ) AS fwd_torque
  CROSS JOIN (
	SELECT
	  greptime_timestamp AS time,
	  "ShearBeamCalculated.Value" AS torque
	FROM public.marpower__150000propulsion__pcs_aft
	WHERE $__timeFilter(greptime_timestamp)
	ORDER BY greptime_timestamp DESC
	LIMIT 1
  ) AS aft_torque
)
SELECT
  time,  
  motor_torque,
  aradex1_torque,
  aradex2_torque,
  measured_torque,
  motor_torque - (measured_torque * ${gear_ratio})                                       AS abs_loss,
  (100 * (motor_torque - (measured_torque * ${gear_ratio})) / GREATEST(ABS(motor_torque), 1)) AS rel_loss
FROM torque_values
